canonical_skill_name: Keddeh Systems — How to Derive Task-Specific Code from Requirements, Mechanics, Existing Work, Specifications, and Available Evidence
authoritative_naming_rule: full semantic names are authoritative; abbreviations may only be secondary aliases after demonstrated semantic equivalence
purpose: Derive and validate the task-specific code required by a capability by decomposing the capability into mechanics, mechanics into functions, and functions into required knowledge, reference, and test oracles, then selecting derivation pathways. The underlying mechanics are the governing object; acquisition (and download within it) is a subordinate pathway that supplies source, reference, or oracles and can never be promoted into a capability limitation while other pathways remain available or untested.
governing_rule: A failed acquisition method cannot be promoted into a capability limitation while other derivation pathways remain available or untested.
working_principle: One mechanic, one authoritative implementation, many consumers. Tests verify mechanics; packaging relocates them; repository organisation describes them. None re-implement business logic.
governing_doctrine: Capability is the centre; evidence is a by-product. ACHIEVE -> VERIFY -> IMPROVE -> VERIFY AGAIN -> PRESERVE THE MECHANICS. Exhaust engineering pathways before arguing any limitation.

case_studies.btc: Two faithful projections: resources/btc_case_study.json (amendable derivation-planning data for the general engine) and src/btc/ (executable mechanics implemented once and composed in src/btc/pipeline.py). The Bitcoin protocol is illustrative, not a locked topic.
